Subject: Re: Consolidated evidence queue & quick score ask — candidate: Juneeta Chowdhury

Folks —

Score: 2

Evidence (3 bullets — why lower):
- During system design they suggested an async-only fallback which introduces consistency edge cases; no concrete plan for cache invalidation under our SLA.
- When asked about an ambiguity in the prompt they deferred to "team to decide" rather than proposing a mitigation. That plus the KV example gap makes me worry about independent execution in this role.
- Behavioral: hesitant when asked to give a recent example of shipping under ambiguity (couldn't name a stakeholder trade-off).

I added inline annotations in the shared doc where we should escalate for a small reference check (ex-manager on delivery). If we keep this candidate open, I recommend one targeted follow-up focused on execution and a short engineering readout.

Olga
